name: rolling-number-stepper
title: Rolling Number Stepper
author: henriquegpb <https://github.com/henriquegpb>
description: A minus and plus stepper where only the digits that change roll, up on the way up and down on the way down, and a digit that appears or disappears opens or closes its column; holding a button keeps stepping.
docs: Live preview and the CSS, JavaScript and Tailwind variants: https://microkit.co/components/rolling-number-stepper
